style: Psychedelic folk-funk, unhurried 70 BPM sway, late-night gathering storytelling. Female lead, warm slightly smoky alto, close-mic, wry and rhythmic, half-sung half-spoken, relaxed phrasing. Rough mixed crowd shouts answers in call-and-response choruses. Instruments: droning sitar with sitar riffs; tabla; fingerpicked acoustic guitar; fuzz-wah electric guitar that builds slowly through the song; deep slow-funk bass; hand-drum groove; handclaps. Warm analog tape, roomy reverb, hypnotic, sly, smoke-filled room
exclude: screaming, rap, fast rap, double-time flow, trap hi-hats, EDM drops, autotune
